newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli forces release Lebanese journalist.
newsitem.headline: Israeli forces release Lebanese journalist.

text.p: Israeli forces released on Wednesday a Lebanese television journalist detained in south Lebanon last month, security sources said.
Roger Nahra, his two brothers and their cousin were arrested by Israeli forces and reportedly taken to Israel.
It was not clear why they were arrested. The three other men were not freed.
Nahra's release came after the London-based human rights group Amnesty International this week expressed concern over his well-being.
Nahra is a cameraman for Lebanon's MTV private television network.
Israel holds a 15-km (nine-mile)-wide border zone in south Lebanon. Pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas are fighting to oust Israeli troops and their local militia allies from the zone.
